about.html.description: Learn about Senior Living Kit’s mission to guide families with assisted living, senior care solutions, and compassionate housing support services.
blocks: Your life still deserves new beginnings .

We know that choosing senior living isn’t just a practical decision—it’s an emotional one. Senior Living Kit was founded to take the stress out of the process, offering expert guidance, a curated network of trusted providers, and heartfelt support.
To empower seniors and their families with the knowledge and resources they need to make confident, informed decisions about their next chapter.
A world where aging is met with dignity, clarity, and ease, where families feel supported every step of the way.

Senior Living Kit was born from a lifetime of caregiving and a deep understanding of the challenges families face when navigating senior care. Growing up in a multigenerational home, I understand the choices adult children have to make while confronted with the care of their elderly loved ones. I can empathize with older adults when they are needing to downsize their home and belongings. Letting go of "stuff", community and your familiar environment is challenging to say the least. Facing any new chapter of life comes with some anxiety, but I know it is important to think of it as a new beginning and not a loss. I witnessed firsthand the beauty and struggles of caring for loved ones at home. Later, I spent nearly 14 years in the senior living industry, learning how the right community can transform the quality of life for older adults and their families. I founded this company to be the guide I wish I’d had—offering hands-on, concierge-style support to families so they never have to make these tough decisions alone.”
Get started with Senior Living Kit , today.

services.html.description: Get expert senior care consulting, housing guidance, and placement services. Senior Living Kit helps families find the right senior living solutions easily.
blocks: A Roadmap to Senior Living – Designed for You
From housing options to healthcare connections, we provide the resources and support you need.
At Senior Living Kit, we offer two distinct types of support— placement services and consulting services —to meet you exactly where you are in your journey.
Consulting Services - $150/hour Not ready to move—or need support beyond placement? We offer paid consulting services to guide you through other complex areas of senior care.
Not sure which path is right for you? Let’s talk. We’ll help you understand your options and build a plan that works for your family.

Placement Services - FREE If you or your loved one is ready to explore senior living communities, we offer hands-on placement support at no cost to families . We're compensated by the community you choose, so you can receive expert guidance without the added financial burden. We work primarily in Central Texas - Georgetown, Austin, Roundrock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, San Antonio
